events.title: Demo Update 1.9 — Stability Patch
events.summary: Update 1.9 is a stability patch for Warrior Quest, with two fixes: Fixed 6 GB graphics card performance: Fixed an issue that made some 6 GB cards run diplomacy on the CPU instead of the GPU. Diplomacy is now 20 times faster on affected systems. Diplomacy recognition: Fixed common phrases such as “How much gold do you want?” and “I’ll give you 7” being misunderstood.

events.title: Demo Update 1.8 — Achievements
events.summary: Achievements have arrived in Warrior Quest! Unlock them as you play and explore. Added Achievements to unlock as you play. Your current quest now appears in the town square. Fixed Fixed an issue that incorrectly placed Macs capable of running the full experience into Light mode. Share your progress and feedback on r/WarriorQuest, and follow @WizardOfTheNorthGames on YouTube for videos and updates.

events.title: Demo Update 1.7 — Warrior Quest Comes to Mac
events.summary: Warrior Quest is now available on Mac! Demo Update 1.7 brings the adventure to Apple Silicon with a native Mac build. Mac support Play the demo on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or newer), running macOS 14 or later. Macs with 12 GB of memory or more are fully supported. Macs with 8 GB can run the game in Light mode. events.title: Demo Major Update 1.6 — Warrior Quest Opens to More Players
events.summary: 1.6 is a major update focused on making Warrior Quest accessible to more players. Lower graphics-memory requirements expand the range of supported PCs, while changes to the bundled voice software reduce false-positive antivirus detections that could interrupt installation or launch. Alongside those changes, this update adds animations to everyday actions and transitions, a new 3D die, rerolls, and improvements across the game. events.summary: Demo 1.5 is live! Stealth automatically attempts to sneak past creatures; Investigative helps you spot traps. Both take more time per step. events.title: Demo Update 1.3 — Patch Notes
events.summary: Voice input, dialogue fast-forward, diplomacy improvements, and fixes. Notes for versions 1.2 and 1.1 are included below under Previous updates. 1.3 Added Voice input: use the mic button beside the input box or press Ctrl+Space. Esc cancels. Brave sends the message instantly; Cautious leaves it in the editor. Fast-forward button to skip voice lines: use the top bar or press F10.
